sentence: This project builds a system that gives cells grown in laboratory incubators daily rhythms by changing the temperature.
This project builds an imager that senses only the spectral bands it needs and sorts hyperspectral images on the device itself.
This project develops a method that uses coral records and sediment cores to follow climate changes from seasonal to millennial timescales.
This project builds an automated system that extracts DNA from samples and prepares it for sequencing in space and other harsh environments.
This project builds a system that uses natural language processing to score revisions of essays and give feedback on how evidence is used.
This project builds ways to make 3D maps and wireless networks in underground mines using millimeter-wave signals and deep learning.
This project studies how electrochemical reactions change nanostructured metal oxides into metastable crystalline materials.
This project builds a method that uses weaker signals from smaller low-resolution images to work out detailed labels for very large images.
This project uses machine learning to search for quantum materials and to control quantum computers better.
This project studies high power lasers and their use in laser fusion research.
This project uses cryo-electron tomography to study how DNA in chromosomes folds into open euchromatin or condensed heterochromatin.
This project studies how changing layouts and traffic rules in places like warehouses helps large teams of autonomous agents move without collisions.
This project builds scaffolds whose stiffness changes with an electric potential to find out how stiffness affects the growth of ovarian follicles.
This project uses artificial intelligence to predict and design superconducting materials, then makes and tests selected candidates.
This project tests whether non-coding RNA stores simple memory in marine snails by comparing RNA from trained and untrained animals.
